name: What is considered a tiny home and what are the typical dimensions?

mainEntity.name: What is considered a tiny home and what are the typical dimensions?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tiny home is generally defined as a dwelling under 400 square feet, excluding lofts. While there's no universal legal definition, common dimensions for tiny homes on wheels are 8.5 feet wide, 13.5 feet tall, and 20-40 feet long to comply with road regulations. Stationary tiny homes can have more flexible dimensions but still aim for a compact footprint. Our custom designs ensure your tiny home meets both your needs and local zoning requirements.
